Problem Description
:  DC_Coils_MG1-MG4_SelfTest, QA11-12 coil stuck ON feedback
Troubleshooting
: Please align for the site intervention, as the contactors are stuck in the 'ON' feedback state, even after the OFF command is given. We need to check the external power supply of 24VDC to the coils to see if the inside coils are receiving voltage. Using a multimeter, check the continuity of the main contact after removing the external power supply. If continuity is present, it means the internal contacts are damaged, and we will need to replace the contactors.
MLFB :  8EM5903-0AA00-7AA8 ( 2nos.) for QA11 & QA12.
